_comment: samo-server credentials for the Now Playing card.
Copy this to /etc/magicmirror-secondbrain/samo.json ON THE MIRROR and put a
real token in it. Never commit the filled-in copy -- .gitignore keeps every
non-example json in this directory out of the repo.
Without this file the Now Playing module simply does not run, which is the
supported way to turn it off.
baseUrl  -- where samo-server listens. The mirror and samo-server are the
same machine, so loopback is both the default and the right
answer; a LAN address works and only adds a hop.
token    -- a samo API token. Make one in samo under its user/token
settings. It is only ever used server-side: the module fetches
cover art itself and hands the browser finished pixels, so the
token never reaches the kiosk page.
deviceId -- which samo-radio device to watch. Leave empty and the module
picks the one that is actually playing, falling back to the
first enabled one. Set it if you have more than one box and
only care about the room the wall is in. GET /api/v1/samo-radio
/devices lists the ids.
timeoutMs -- per-request deadline. 6s is generous for loopback.
schedules -- optional. Which internet radio stations publish a
schedule, so the card can say what is on next. Keyed by the
station's name in samo (or its id). The BBC needs no entry:
every BBC stream URL carries the service id and the wall
recognises it. An NPR member station on Composer needs its
24-character ucs id, which is in the station's own playlist
or schedule widget (view the page source and look for
ucs=...); either paste that widget link into the station's
homepage field in samo, or put the id here. A station with
no schedule anywhere simply gets no line, which is right.
The two entries below are examples: rename the keys to your
stations' names, or delete them.
